title: Crossings in random square tilings
exact_target: Show that random square tilings always have a uniformly positive horizontal crossing probability and approach one half as the largest tile shrinks.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 10000051 (AMR-099-0051). CC BY 4.0.
